items.text:
I've followed this game's development for years. I loved Neoscavenger (the developer's last game) and a sci-fi sandbox space sim set in the same universe sounded amazing. 

I finally decided to pull the trigger and buy it, but I just cannot recommend it in its current state. I suspect that if this is what they consider a 1.0 release after half a decade of development, then these glaring issues will probably never be fully addressed.

So many of the game systems are bizarrely obtuse. For instance, your psychological needs are generally satisfied through dialogue with NPCs in a system the devs call "social combat." I'm sorry, what? This is the worst attempt at dialogue gamification since Oblivion's persuasion wheel. Worse yet, several "gigs" require you to stumble through this social combat sequence with no clear guidance, just hoping that the interaction you need pops up.

There is so much potential here. The game can be really fun at times. It's really satisfying to find a derelict with good parts, repair them, and sell them or use them to upgrade your ship. But those moments only punctuate a long, tedious slog. 

It just feels like somewhere along the way the developers forgot that they're making a game.
items.text_zh:
我关注这款游戏的开发已经好几年了。我很喜欢Neoscavenger（这位开发者的上一款游戏），而一款设定在同一宇宙中的科幻沙盒太空模拟游戏听起来太棒了。

我终于决定下定决心买下它，但我实在无法推荐它目前的状态。我怀疑，如果这就是他们开发了五年之后所认为的1.0正式版，那么这些显而易见的问题可能永远都不会被完全解决。

游戏中有太多系统晦涩得令人匪夷所思。比如说，你的心理需求通常是通过与NPC对话来满足的，开发者把这套系统称为“社交战斗”。不好意思，什么？这是自《湮灭》的说服轮盘以来对对话游戏化最糟糕的尝试。更糟的是，好几个“任务”要求你在毫无明确指引的情况下摸索着完成这套社交战斗流程，只能指望你需要的互动恰好出现。

这里面有太多潜力了。这游戏有时候真的很好玩。找到一艘带有好零件的废弃飞船，把它们修好，然后卖掉或者用来升级你的飞船，真的很有满足感。但这些时刻只是点缀在漫长而乏味的苦差事之中。

就感觉在某个环节上，开发者忘了他们是在做一款游戏。
